verdict.rationale: The CLI ships a documented `skills init [name]` command that creates a new SKILL.md template, directly addressing authoring without reverse-engineering existing skills, and there's a validator (skills-ref validate) referenced in the spec docs. However, evidence never shows the actual generated template content, its frontmatter fields (name/description), or a walkthrough of authoring beyond the bare command listing. missing for 10: sample SKILL.md template contents/frontmatter schema shown, hands-on/community confirmation that `skills init` produces a usable starting point, and detailed authoring documentation beyond a one-line command table entry.
